title: Honestly, I can't wait for this box every month!~
text: Someone started gifting me this box 2 years ago. After the gifts ran out, I just had to sign up myself. I LOVE this box. It's like christmas morning when it arrives and it makes me feel so special and loved. I loved the things that come inside, especially the affirmation cards and games to get to know yourself more. They always have a ton of skin care items- my favorites are the beauty tools and all the organic vegan products. If I had a young teen daughgter, I would SOOOO gift this to her- its so sweet and makes you feel so loved. Really love this box. It's my monthly self care. <3
label: positive
